findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "start_kr_law_intake" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Clarify-first intake for Korean tax, accounting, labor, administrative, court/registry, insurance, customs, patent/trademark, appraisal/compensation and real es…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_sales_rebates, compare_kr_ticket_vs_presale_tax · Private data: compare_kr_retirement_pension, check_kr_subcontract_direct_payment, check_kr_family_loan_interest, check_kr_special_supply, get_kr_professional_scope, start_kr_law_intake · Public sink: value_kr_unlisted_shares, calculate_kr_family_business_deduction, classify_bcg_portfolio, check_kr_special_supply, start_kr_law_intake.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_sales_rebates, compare_kr_ticket_vs_presale_tax · Private data: compare_kr_retirement_pension, check_kr_subcontract_direct_payment, check_kr_family_loan_interest, check_kr_special_supply, get_kr_professional_scope, start_kr_law_intake · Public sink: value_kr_unlisted_shares, calculate_kr_family_business_deduction, classify_bcg_portfolio, check_kr_special_supply, start_kr_law_intake

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
